title: Returns & Exchanges: Merchandise and Sales Tax Credited on a Returned Line
content:
On a Returns & Exchanges return in status inspected, each returned order line is credited a merchandise credit and a sales tax credited. This sheet sets out how both figures are worked out from the inspection entries and the Online Orders records of the order.

## Calculation

1. **Line and units.** The line credited is the order line whose inspection entries show units accepted or accepted with fee. Its accepted units are the units on those inspection entries, both outcomes counted together; rejected and missing units are not accepted units.
2. **Net unit price paid.** The booked unit price of the line, less the checkout promotion discount allocated to the line, any late promotion credit on the line and any price adjustment on the line, each of those divided by the units booked on the line.
3. **Merchandise credit.** The net unit price paid times the accepted units, rounded half up to the cent.
4. **Sales tax credited.** The order's sales tax charged at placement, times the line's merchandise credit, divided by the order's net merchandise at placement (the merchandise subtotal less the discount total). The multiplication and the division are done once on the unrounded quotient, and the result is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

## Where each figure comes from

| Figure | Record |
|---|---|
| Accepted units | The return's inspection entries for the line (outcome accepted or accepted with fee) |
| Booked unit price, units booked, checkout promotion discount | The order's booking line |
| Late promotion credit, price adjustment | The late promotion and price adjustment entries on the order line |
| Sales tax at placement, merchandise subtotal, discount total | The order as placed |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

An order line was booked at 80.00 USD per unit for 2 units, with a checkout promotion discount of 16.00 USD allocated to it and no late promotion credit or price adjustment. Both units were accepted at inspection. The order was placed with a merchandise subtotal of 180.00 USD, a discount total of 16.00 USD and sales tax of 13.20 USD.

- Net unit price paid: 16.00 divided by 2 is 8.00, so 80.00 less 8.00 is 72.00.
- Merchandise credit: 72.00 times 2 is 144.00.
- Net merchandise at placement: 180.00 less 16.00 is 164.00.
- Sales tax credited: 13.20 times 144.00 divided by 164.00 is 11.5902…, rounded half up to 11.59.

The line is credited 144.00 of merchandise and 11.59 of sales tax.

## Second illustration (hypothetical)

A line of 3 units shows 2 units accepted and 1 unit accepted with fee: its accepted units are 3. If the same line instead shows 2 accepted and 1 rejected, its accepted units are 2.
